name: Walking
steps: Stand tall with your gaze forward, shoulders relaxed down, core lightly braced, and arms bent comfortably at your sides.
Step smoothly forward in steady alternating strides, rolling cleanly from your heel through the midfoot and pushing off your toes.
Swing your arms naturally forward and back in rhythm with your opposite legs.
Continue walking at a comfortable, steady pace, then slow down to finish.
tips: Keep your posture tall rather than slouching forward or looking down at your feet.
Take crisp, natural strides instead of reaching your front heel excessively far ahead.
